line: A last-minute task lands today. Do it well, then log off on time.
Dress a little sharper today. Someone important remembers first impressions.
Say yes to Friday plans. A useful contact might be there. Your budget might not.
Payday maths day. Move some into savings before the weekend sales find you.
Weekend mood starts early. Plan something fun, but keep today's promises first.
You'll want to correct everyone today. Choose the one correction that matters.
Your squad is strong today. Plan the weekend before it becomes a 40-message debate.
Friendly competition at work or the gym today. Win it, then share your tip.
Your gut is right about someone today. Keep it to yourself for now.
Let someone treat you today. Say thank you, not 'aiyah, no need'.
